articles.title: Nifty 50 Breaches Historical Highs as FII Buying Surges Across Banking & IT Heavyweights
articles.excerpt: Indian benchmark indices continued their bullish momentum as foreign institutional investors poured over ₹4,200 crore into domestic equities.
content: ### Institutional Inflows Drive Benchmark Surge
Domestic benchmark index Nifty 50 crossed historical intraday highs on Wednesday, buoyed by sustained foreign portfolio investment into banking, technology, and auto majors.
### Key Sectoral Drivers
HDFC Bank, Reliance Industries, and ICICI Bank contributed over 140 points to the rally. Market breadth remained strongly positive with 1,840 advancing stocks against 620 declining issues on the NSE.
### Analyst Outlook
Equity strategists highlight strong corporate earnings expectations and stable macroeconomic fundamentals as key pillars supporting long-term Indian market valuations.

articles.seo_description: Nifty 50 breaches record high on back of ₹4,200 crore FII buying across banking and IT stocks.
key_takeaways: Nifty 50 reached fresh historical highs backed by FII inflows of ₹4,200 crore.
Banking and IT stocks led broad-based rally on National Stock Exchange.
Market advance-decline ratio stood strongly in favor of bulls at 3:1.

articles.title: RBI Monetary Policy Committee Maintains Repo Rate at 6.50% to Ensure Durable Disinflation
articles.excerpt: The Reserve Bank of India unanimously decided to keep benchmark policy rates unchanged while reiterating its stance of withdrawal of accommodation.
content: ### Policy Rate Announcement
The RBI Governor announced that the Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) voted to keep the policy repo rate unchanged at 6.50%. The standing deposit facility (SDF) rate remains at 6.25%.
### Economic Growth Projections
India’s real GDP growth for the financial year is projected at 7.2%, reflecting strong investment demand, government capital expenditure, and robust services export activity.
### Inflation Outlook
Retail inflation (CPI) projections remain anchored around 4.5%, supported by normal monsoon progression and favorable food supply dynamics.

articles.seo_description: RBI MPC holds repo rate at 6.50% with GDP growth target set at 7.2%. Full economic analysis.
key_takeaways: RBI MPC keeps repo rate steady at 6.50% in unanimous policy vote.
FY GDP growth forecast maintained at strong 7.2%.
Bank Nifty responded positively with intraday gains of 0.85%.

articles.title: Reliance Industries Outlines $10B Green Energy Expansion and Solar Giga-Factory Roadmap
articles.excerpt: Reliance Industries accelerates its net-zero carbon strategy by commissioning multi-gigawatt solar module and green hydrogen electrolyzer plants.
content: ### Green Energy Capital Expenditure
Reliance Industries Chairman announced key milestones in the group’s $10 billion green energy gigafactory complex in Jamnagar, Gujarat.
### Solar & Hydrogen Manufacturing
The initial phase of the high-efficiency solar module factory will commence production this quarter, targeting 20 GW total capacity by 2026.
### Clean Energy Transition
The green hydrogen manufacturing hub will supply industrial feedstocks for refining and chemical operations while expanding clean power supply.
